item.title: Next to 'college crescent' sign - original ref 9648377, 8th September
item.description:
Closed and updated as fixed, but nothing has been done? See original report (9648377) for photos - Reporting a missing street nameplate for Belsize Lane at its intersection with Fitzjohn’s Avenue. The original wall that prominently displayed the Belsize Lane signage was severely damaged during a vehicular collision. Following the site clearance, a replacement sign was unfortunately never reinstated. The absence of this signage is cause navigational confusion for motorists including visitors to residents of the street. Because the street nameplate for the adjacent roadway, College Crescent, remains fully visible, drivers turning off Fitzjohn’s Avenue naturally conclude that the entire junction belongs exclusively to College Crescent. As a result, motorists seeking Belsize Lane frequently miss the turn, leading to erratic braking and sudden U-turns at a heavily trafficked junction.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 120, Belsize Lane, Belsize Park, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
